language_context.national_language_note: English is the official language of the United States under Executive Order 14224, signed March 1, 2025. The designation is by executive order, not by an amendment to the U.S. Constitution.
language_context.diversity_note: The U.S. Census Bureau's 2017–2021 detailed language tables cover more than 500 individual languages and language groups spoken at home. This catalog is a starting index, not a complete inventory.
language_context.documentation_unit: Language and community profiles are separate from the country record. A language used in multiple countries must not be duplicated as a different language.

languages.name: Chinese language groups
languages.note: This is a navigation umbrella, not a single language record. Split into individually identified languages such as cmn, yue, wuu, nan and hak as supported by community and region-specific research.

languages.name: Arabic varieties
languages.note: Arabic varieties are not one language profile. Identify individual varieties and communities (for example, Egyptian, Levantine, Iraqi or other groups) only after confirming the catalog evidence and language-code scope.
